body: Worker rule (Termal::BarA1, from Fable2 #381, 2026-10-18 20:05Z): run FOCUSED warm checks in the FOREGROUND one-call form (`pushd "ROOT" && node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused -- …` with no run_in_background), because a focused warm run finishes well under the Bash tool's 10-minute cap. Run FULL gates with `--detach --notify <coordinator>` in the foreground (memory detached-gate-preferred-2026-10-09). Reason: Bash-background launches put "this session's own Claude work … has no verified completion" on the session, and the host refused credit for w-52222's background gate test-bca8971b (check 30df78b7) on exactly that.
